highlights: Fix Update Compatible AI Tools failing with 'unsafe transaction file' on hosts with large OpenClaw state: manifest readers and producers share one 16 MiB contract.
Fix recovery after an interruption between migration-prepared and commit: rollback now completes instead of leaving the gateway fenced (prepared artifact drift).
Oversized OpenClaw state inventories fail closed with a clear error before any package or gateway transition.
Release gates cover production-scale manifests, size boundaries, and sealed-manifest rollback; transactions sealed by 5.0.4 remain reconcilable.
